# JUPASCal 2027 — unofficial fork of JUPASCal 2026

> JUPASCal 2027 is an unofficial fork of the original JUPASCal 2026 project at
> <https://jupascal.com/>. It is a free JUPAS / HKDSE admission-score calculator:
> enter your DSE grades to estimate your score under each programme's 2027
> subject weighting, then compare it with the 2026 intake's published
> lower-quartile, median and upper-quartile scores.

- 2027 live site: <https://jupascalc.spooky.hk/>
- 2027 source (MIT License): <https://github.com/SpookyKipper/JupasCalculator>

## Key facts

- Covers the 2027 JUPAS catalogue across 10 institutions: HKU, CUHK, HKUST, PolyU, CityUHK, HKBU, Lingnan University, EdUHK, HKMU and the SSSDP programmes.
- Uses 2027 subject weightings and entrance requirements, with 2026 intake admission scores (LQ / median / UQ, or a published mean) as benchmarks.
- The 2027 weightings, requirements, 2026 intake scores and admission statistics were gathered with **AI assistance** and manual spot-checks.
- **Accuracy is not guaranteed.** The data may contain errors, omissions or out-of-date figures. Always verify against official JUPAS and institution publications.
- Open source under the **MIT License**; see `LICENSE` in the 2027 repository.
- Free, bilingual (English / 中文), no sign-up. Unofficial and for reference only.

## Original project

- Original 2026 JUPASCal live site: <https://jupascal.com/>
- Original 2026 JUPASCal source: <https://github.com/JUPASCal/JUPASCal.github.io>

## Disclaimer

This is an independent, unofficial fork. It is not affiliated with JUPAS, any
university, or the original JUPASCal maintainers. Scores are estimates only, not
predictions or guarantees of admission.
